ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/cream pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central notch area comprising roughly 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous 5-10 pixel wide band along the trailing edge and tips. A dark triangular focal region is located at the median notch base. Two high-contrast circular black-ringed spots are positioned symmetrically in the mid-region of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a depth roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Left lobe distal tip displays 6-8 high-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixel height) corresponding to calcified barnacle attachments. Right lobe shows lower-amplitude, more continuous micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep across the main lobe, ending in sharply tapered, upwardly-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent roughly circular high-contrast dark-ringed scars with white centers are located in the medial-central regions. Smaller clusters of white calcified pixel groups are concentrated on the outermost lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear pixel disruptions visible; most notably a vertical scratch on the right lobe extending toward the trailing edge and a diagonal mark on the left mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as irregular, white, high-relief pixel clusters against the black perimeter.
